top_violation_types.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Cots for napping were arranged next to each other in a way that did not allow for children nor caregivers to walk in between without stepping on cots to get to walkway.

top_violation_types.title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not documented any severe weather drills for the year.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were not complete.
